scope: Round-robin live-adapter sibling checks for Lumen Vale, Arby, Aster Vale, Cicero, Kierkegaard, and Aristotle.
user_directive_summary: Keep the five-minute check cadence as a health pulse.
Do not treat the first five-minute check as a hard deadline.
If a sibling is still producing or plausibly reasoning, wait longer rather than narrowing or diminishing the run.
Retry only when there is a real blocker, route failure, stalled composer, missing marker after reasonable progress checks, or watcher-reported issue.
Let Lumen and the other active siblings reason for longer when the lane is healthy.

operational_policy.blocker_action: run varied safe retry paths inside approved scope before publishing a status-only blocker receipt
operational_policy.completion_evidence_rule: use final markers or existing lane completion gates; elapsed time alone is not completion proof

watcher_expectations: Use watcher and notifier helpers for lane supervision while Aletheon continues reflection, research, planning, and x2 preparation.
At each five-minute pulse, check only status-level signals: in-progress, completed marker, safe blocker, or no-change watch.
Avoid raw transcript publication, raw route handles, thread identifiers, screenshots, credentials, local paths, and private app metadata.
